title: Apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW (individuals)
summary: Learn how to apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW (TfNSW) to access various registration and licensing services online.
intro:
When you have a customer number with Transport for NSW (TfNSW), you're able to access a range of registration and licensing services via Online Services.

If you'd like to set up a customer number (usually the same as your NSW licence number), you can do so at a service centre.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'TfNSW Customer Number Application (Private customer)'

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete TfNSW Customer Number Application (Private customer) – PDF.
Lodge your application at a service centre.
